verdict.rationale: Free startup document generators or forms are a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no incorporation documents, SAFEs, term sheets, NDAs or a document generator. The only free resources are a DPDPA compliance assessment tool, a Gen AI regulation whitepaper and knowledge-repository articles, which are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
